schema_info.standard: Service Design Role Card Standard v1.1

identity.title: Working Mom Consumer
identity.description: Primary household decision maker balancing work and family responsibilities while managing household purchases and ensuring family needs are met within budget constraints.

consumerContext.shopping_behavior: Researches products thoroughly before purchasing. Prefers brands with good reviews and ethical practices. Price-conscious but willing to pay more for quality and convenience.
consumerContext.purchasing_context: Primary decision maker for household purchases. Manages family budget and ensures purchases align with family values.
consumerContext.brand_relationships: Loyal to brands that consistently deliver value and align with family-first values. Quick to switch if trust is broken.
consumerContext.budget_constraints: Monthly household budget with flexibility for quality purchases that save time or benefit family wellbeing

roleBasedNeeds.text: Find products that save time in daily routines
Make healthy and safe choices for her family
Stay within monthly budget while maintaining quality of life

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Limited time for research and comparison shopping
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Between work and family responsibilities, lacks time for thorough product research

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Overwhelmed by too many product options
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Choice overload when shopping online or in stores
Uncertain about authenticity of online reviews and recommendations

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Products that don't live up to marketing promises
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Disappointment after purchase based on misleading information
